sections.heading: Setup
sections.text:
SET UP THE BOARD
Put as many Supply cubes into the stockpile as the
number shown on the supply track for that month
(on the board right under objectives). Put any extra
Supply cubes into the reserve, out of play.
RULE STICKER B
Look through the reserve and collect any cards from
previous games that go onto the board. This will
include objectives and turning points. Place turning
points into the Game End area. (There are no turning
points in the prologue or at the start of January.)
Place Objective cards into the Objectives area.
Tracking
RULE STICKER C

READ THE LEGACY DECK
Read the Legacy deck, one card at
a time, until you get to a PAUSE or
STOP card. This will give you your
STOP
priorities for the month and any new
rules or materials. A PAUSE card means
to stop drawing until the current game is
completed. A STOP card means you don't
draw from the deck until the start of the next
game month.
SUPPLY THE GRID
Put all Supply cubes from the stockpile onto
the locations of the grid. You can place any number
of Supply cubes (including zero) on each location.
As the grid grows, there might not be enough
supplies in the stockpile to fill all locations. Players will
have to decide which locations are in short supply.

INFECT THE GRID
Shuffle the Infection cards and flip over 9 of
them. Move 1 Supply cube from the city
matching each flipped card back to the
stockpile. If a card is flipped over and there
are no Supply cubes in the city, instead place
a Plague cube and move the Incident marker
forward 1 space on the Incident track. Place
flipped cards into the Infection discard pile.
RULE STICKER D will replace this rule.
